premise: The ball watches the rubber ring and the bottle bobbing on the waves and wishes it could too; a puff of wind rolls it down to the water's edge, and the wind rolls it home again.
inspiration: The wish-granted tale of the folk tradition (the pancake who wanted to roll), granted gently by the wind, there and back.
lesson: Little adventures are best when you get home again.

en-US.title: The Ball Goes for a Swim
en-US.text: {ball:enter} {ball:go to sand} The ball sat all cosy and warm, red and yellow and blue and white, watching {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} the rubber ring and {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to sea} the bottle bobbing out on the water. [curious] Bob, bob, bob. It looked like fun. {ball:pulse} {canvas:wind 0.7 20s} {sfx:gust} Then, whoosh! A puff of wind came along, {ball:go to shore right} and the ball went rolling, bump, bump, bump, all the way to the water's edge. {ball:spin} SPLASH! [laughs] It bobbed in the foam. {ring:live} The ring turned round to say hello. {bottle:live} The bottle popped its cork, as if to cheer. [happily] Three floaters, bobbing together. {ball:float 0.5} Bob, bob, bob! {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Up on the rocks, {pelican:face happy} Pelican {pelican:live} scooped a beakful of water. [short pause] Then the wind turned, {ball:go to sand} and rolled the ball all the way back again. {ball:live} It spun round, and stopped, just where it had started. {ball:sparkle} A little wet. A little sandy. And very, very happy.

es-ES.title: La pelota se va a nadar
es-ES.text: {ball:enter} {ball:go to sand} La pelota estaba tan a gusto, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca, mirando cómo {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} el flotador y {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to sea} la botella se mecían en el agua. [curious] Arriba, abajo, arriba. Parecía divertido. {ball:pulse} {canvas:wind 0.7 20s} {sfx:gust} Entonces, ¡fiuuu! Llegó un soplo de viento, {ball:go to shore right} y la pelota salió rodando, bum, bum, bum, hasta el borde del agua. {ball:spin} ¡CHOF! [laughs] Se quedó meciéndose en la espuma. {ring:live} El flotador se giró para saludarla. {bottle:live} La botella hizo saltar su corcho, como para aplaudir. [happily] Tres flotadores, meciéndose juntos. {ball:float 0.5} ¡Arriba, abajo, arriba! {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} En las rocas, {pelican:face happy} Pelícano {pelican:live} recogió un buen trago de agua. [short pause] Luego el viento cambió, {ball:go to sand} y llevó la pelota rodando de vuelta. {ball:live} Dio vueltas y se paró, justo donde había empezado. {ball:sparkle} Un poco mojada. Un poco llena de arena. Y muy, muy contenta.
